description: Permanently deletes a specified reaction from a Trello action. Use when you need to remove a reaction that was previously added to an action.

id.description: The ID of the reaction to delete. This is a unique identifier for the reaction.
id.title: Id

idAction.description: The ID of the Action from which to delete the reaction. This is a unique identifier for the action.
idAction.title: Id Action

name: delete_action_reaction

DeleteActionReactionResponse.title: DeleteActionReactionResponse
